name: read_skill
description:
Load the full body (markdown content) of one or more skills by name. Call this AFTER discover_skills has surfaced candidate names — discover_skills returns headers, read_skill opens them. The returned body is intended to be incorporated into the agent's next planning step like a freshly-injected skill.

Missing names come back in `missing: [...]` — no error. Cap of 5 names per call to keep the context budget sane.

Pairs with discover_skills the way pod_fetch pairs with pod_search.

inputs.name: names
inputs.description: Skill names to load. Example: ['image-resize', 'pod-courier']. Cap 5 per call.

outputs.description: Each found skill's body, separated by '=== skill: <name> ===' markers. Missing names listed at the end.
Structured: {found: [{name, description, body, body_chars}], missing: [name, ...], found_count, missing_count}.

metadata.planner_description: Load full SKILL.md bodies by name (after discover_skills). Returns each body plus any missing names. Cap 5 names per call.
